prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1058; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the facts, but I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: Understood. Can you walk me through where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in League City, on a multi-lane road heading toward the interchange. Traffic was moderate and I needed to move one lane over because my exit was coming up.

Q: What did you do before changing lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. I saw a gap, so I signaled and started to move over.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point before contact?

A: Not clearly. I felt a jolt on the driver's side and heard a loud scrape. By the time I looked, the other car was already alongside me and then it pulled ahead.

Q: Did you or the other driver stop afterward?

A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. We exchanged information and stayed there until the police officer arrived.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My right shoulder hit the door frame and it's been sore and stiff since. I went to be checked out that same day and I'm still having trouble lifting my arm above my head.

Q: Have you received any medical treatment since then?

A: I've had two follow-up visits and I'm scheduled for physical therapy. The doctor said it could take several weeks to improve.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was trying to drive carefully and I'm hoping this gets resolved quickly so I can get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
